 Rick Osentoski-Imagn Images Rick Osentoski-Imagn Images Canadiens Top Prospect Is Only Continuing To Dominate
 Michael DeRosa Partner Nov 6, 2026 1:00 AM Published Nov 6, 2026 1:00 AM This Canadiens prospect is having a very good season. 
 Montreal Canadiens top prospect Michael Hage is continuing to shine with Michigan this season.
 In just nine games so far this campaign with the school, Hage has recorded four goals, 16 assists, and 20 points. These are very good offensive numbers, and they undoubtedly show that the Canadiens top prospect has plenty of skill and upside. 
 Hage is not showing any signs of slowing down right now, either. Over his last five games, he has recorded eight points. With this, the 2024 first-round is playing some incredible hockey right now. This should only create more excitement about his future in the NHL.
 The Canadiens will be hoping that Hage can continue to shine at the collegiate level as this season carries on. There is no question that they need help at center, so they need Hage to continue to develop in the right direction.
 Related stories
 More Videos It will be fascinating to see how Hage performs as this campaign rolls on. Right now, it is hard not to be encouraged with how he is playing right now with Michigan.
 In 81 games over three seasons with Michigan so far, Hage has posted 30 goals, 76 assists, and 106 points.
